caption: The drawing depicts a large sailing ship positioned in profile on a beige background with brown stains and smudges scattered throughout. The hull of the ship is long and painted in dark brown or black, with a lighter band of color running along the top. There are three tall masts, each with multiple horizontal spars supporting square sails that are colored in varying shades of gray and brown, showing some texture with visible lines indicating folds and rigging. The sails are arranged in three vertical rows along the masts, with an additional set of three smaller triangular sails extending forward from the bow. There is fine black linework indicating rigging, ropes, and structural details such as the ship’s railings and deck features. The composition is simple, with the ship occupying most of the frame, and no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Pa. German Ship
